descricao: alocacao diaria de aeronaves nas posicoes do patio por faixa de horario

colunas.schemaXml: <Field Type='Text' MaxLength='60' Required='TRUE' Indexed='TRUE' DisplayName='aeroporto' Name='aeroporto' StaticName='aeroporto' Group='AirportNow'/>
<Field Type='DateTime' Format='DateOnly' Required='TRUE' Indexed='TRUE' DisplayName='data_operacao' Name='data_operacao' StaticName='data_operacao' Group='AirportNow'/>

<Field Type='DateTime' Format='DateOnly' Required='TRUE' Indexed='TRUE' DisplayName='data_fim' Name='data_fim' StaticName='data_fim' Group='AirportNow'><Validation Message='a data final nao pode ser anterior a data inicial'>=[data_fim]>=[data_operacao]</Validation></Field>
<Field Type='Number' Decimals='0' Min='1' Required='TRUE' Indexed='TRUE' DisplayName='id_posicao' Name='id_posicao' StaticName='id_posicao' Group='AirportNow'/>
<Field Type='Text' MaxLength='10' Required='TRUE' DisplayName='posicao_txt' Name='posicao_txt' StaticName='posicao_txt' Group='AirportNow'/>
<Field Type='Text' MaxLength='20' Required='TRUE' DisplayName='patio_txt' Name='patio_txt' StaticName='patio_txt' Group='AirportNow'/>
<Field Type='Text' MaxLength='10' Required='FALSE' DisplayName='cia_sigla' Name='cia_sigla' StaticName='cia_sigla' Group='AirportNow'/>
<Field Type='Text' MaxLength='20' Required='FALSE' DisplayName='voo_chegada' Name='voo_chegada' StaticName='voo_chegada' Group='AirportNow'/>
<Field Type='Text' MaxLength='20' Required='FALSE' DisplayName='voo_saida' Name='voo_saida' StaticName='voo_saida' Group='AirportNow'/>
<Field Type='Text' MaxLength='20' Required='FALSE' DisplayName='prefixo' Name='prefixo' StaticName='prefixo' Group='AirportNow'/>
<Field Type='Text' MaxLength='10' Required='FALSE' DisplayName='equipamento' Name='equipamento' StaticName='equipamento' Group='AirportNow'/>
<Field Type='Number' Decimals='2' Min='0' Required='FALSE' DisplayName='envergadura_m' Name='envergadura_m' StaticName='envergadura_m' Group='AirportNow'/>

<Field Type='Number' Decimals='0' Min='0' Required='TRUE' DisplayName='hora_inicio' Name='hora_inicio' StaticName='hora_inicio' Group='AirportNow'><Validation Message='minutos desde 00:00, de 0 a 1439'>=E([hora_inicio]>=0;[hora_inicio]<=1439)</Validation></Field>

<Field Type='Number' Decimals='0' Min='1' Required='TRUE' DisplayName='hora_fim' Name='hora_fim' StaticName='hora_fim' Group='AirportNow'><Validation Message='minutos desde 00:00, de 1 a 1440'>=E([hora_fim]>=1;[hora_fim]<=1440)</Validation></Field>
<Field Type='Text' MaxLength='10' Required='FALSE' DisplayName='portao' Name='portao' StaticName='portao' Group='AirportNow'/>

<Field Type='Text' MaxLength='20' Required='TRUE' DisplayName='tipo_registro' Name='tipo_registro' StaticName='tipo_registro' Group='AirportNow'><Default>VOO</Default><Validation Message='use VOO, INTERDICAO ou RESERVA'>=OU([tipo_registro]="VOO";[tipo_registro]="INTERDICAO";[tipo_registro]="RESERVA")</Validation></Field>

<Field Type='Number' Decimals='0' Min='0' Required='TRUE' DisplayName='pesquisado' Name='pesquisado' StaticName='pesquisado' Group='AirportNow'><Default>0</Default><Validation Message='use 1 ou 0'>=OU([pesquisado]=0;[pesquisado]=1)</Validation></Field>

<Field Type='Number' Decimals='0' Min='0' Required='TRUE' DisplayName='internacional' Name='internacional' StaticName='internacional' Group='AirportNow'><Default>0</Default><Validation Message='use 1 ou 0'>=OU([internacional]=0;[internacional]=1)</Validation></Field>
<Field Type='Note' RichText='FALSE' AppendOnly='FALSE' NumLines='4' Required='FALSE' DisplayName='observacao' Name='observacao' StaticName='observacao' Group='AirportNow'/>
<Field Type='Text' DisplayName='origem' Name='origem' StaticName='origem' Group='AirportNow' MaxLength='30' Required='FALSE' Indexed='TRUE'/>

<Field Type='Number' Decimals='0' Min='0' Required='TRUE' Indexed='TRUE' DisplayName='ativo' Name='ativo' StaticName='ativo' Group='AirportNow'><Default>1</Default><Validation Message='use 1 ou 0'>=OU([ativo]=0;[ativo]=1)</Validation></Field>

validacaoLista.mensagem: quando entra e sai no mesmo dia, o fim tem que ser maior que o inicio
